summary: Iter 88 — Tested (A) GET /api/maps-attachments + Events 'Mappe & Percorsi' dialog UI and (B) POST /api/leads/{id}/demo (Meet simulato) + SA Leads drawer. Backend 6/8 pytest pass. UI: 5/5 checks pass (no 'GPX presente/assente' labels, map-att-<kind>-<mapId>-<field> buttons present, gpx-viewer dialog + gpx-viewer-download link render, PDF href → /api/files/{id} 200, 390px no overflow, SA drawer shows lead-demo-meet with https://meet.google.com/sim-... href). 2 backend failures reveal ONE real bug: _resolve_attachment regex r'/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)$' has an end-anchor so URLs with a query string (e.g. '/api/files/<id>?x=1') don't match → the file is reported as excluded even though it exists in db.files and belongs to the org. Spec explicitly says 'query string ignorata'. Fix: strip the query string before the regex (or change pattern to '/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)(?:\?|$)') in /app/backend/server.py:2293. The public-file regex at line 2289 is already fine (no $ anchor). Confirm/reschedule/cancel + Meet simulato link preserve-on-reschedule / clear-on-cancel all work. QA admin → 403 on /leads/{id}/demo. SA cross-org call to /api/maps-attachments returns 428 (require_admin rejects SA with no org_id) — acceptable.

critical.issue: _resolve_attachment regex has '$' anchor so '/api/files/<id>?x=1' is treated as not-matching and the whole URL falls through to the http-prefix branch (returns None for relative URLs), excluding valid attachments whenever the stored map URL has any query string. Spec requires 'query string ignorata'. Fix: strip querystring or change regex to '/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)(?:\?|$)' at server.py line 2293.

action_items: Fix _resolve_attachment() in /app/backend/server.py (~line 2293): make the /api/files/{id} regex ignore query strings. Suggested: `url_no_q = url.split('?', 1)[0]; m = re.search(r'/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+)$', url_no_q)` — or change pattern to `/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)(?:\?|$)`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2289-2301 _resolve_attachment: the public-token branch regex has no $ anchor (good), but the private /api/files/{id} branch does — inconsistent. Normalize both to tolerate query strings and fragments.
server.py:2267 upload() returns `/api/files/{fid}` for non-public kinds; good — but any caller appending ?v=1 for cache busting will break maps-attachments resolution until the bug above is fixed.
server.py:3819 lead_demo_action always calls demo_booking.sync_lead even for 'cancel' (where Brevo attributes still need to be updated — probably intended, but worth documenting).

demo_booking.meet_for_demo relies on `lead.get('demo_meet_link') or <new sim link>` to preserve the link across reschedule — works, but if lead has demo_meet_link=null (e.g. after a cancel then reschedule), a new sim link is generated. Current spec is OK with that; just noting the semantics.

rca of the issue: RCA: In /app/backend/server.py the helper `_resolve_attachment(url, org_id)` tries to resolve a stored map URL against db.files. The regex for the private download URL `r'/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)$'` is anchored with `$`. When the URL is `/api/files/<id>?x=1` (or any query string), the regex returns None. The code then falls into the `url.startswith('http')` branch — but a relative '/api/files/...' URL does not start with 'http', so the function returns None and the attachment is dropped from the response. The spec explicitly requires that query strings be ignored. Reproduction: POST /api/maps with pdf_url=`/api/files/<validId>?x=1`, then GET /api/maps-attachments?evento_id=<ev> — the resulting items list omits the pdf. Fix: strip the query string before matching (`url.split('?',1)[0]`) OR change the regex to `r'/api/files/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)(?:\?|$)'`. Public-token path (line 2289) is already tolerant because its regex has no `$` anchor.
